_why: 6a-prime was the only `exec agy` path whose deliverable rode the agent's last message alone; four dispatches read the tree and were discarded for the last line. Each mutation carries its own `test` key.

mutations.name: the-report-file-is-never-preferred
mutations._mechanism: The channel is built and then unused — indistinguishable from never having built it, and the last message stays the only surface.
mutations.find:
if report_text is not None:
        review = report_text

mutations.name: an-empty-report-file-is-authoritative
mutations._mechanism: An agent that creates the file and writes nothing is the commonest partial failure. Treating empty as authoritative turns a recoverable verdict in the last message into NO_VERDICT. This row SURVIVED until the reason was made observable: with the branch removed an empty file merely falls through to `_extract_assessment`, which also returns None, so both paths emitted the identical `channel=last-message` and nothing could tell them apart. The guard's only output was being discarded by `score`.

mutations.name: the-fallback-claims-the-file-channel
mutations._mechanism: A verdict recovered from the last message and one read from the file are different evidence. Printing the same channel for both makes the fallback silent, which is the defect one level down. Re-anchored: the fallback line now carries the reason, so the mutation names that line instead. The mechanism is unchanged — a verdict recovered from the last message must not print as one read from the file.

mutations.name: the-channel-is-not-reported-at-all
mutations._mechanism: Without it a reader cannot tell which surface carried the verdict, and the whole point of the change becomes unobservable.

mutations.name: the-slot-leaves-the-shipped-template
mutations._mechanism: The machinery is worthless if the real template never tells the agent where to write.

mutations.name: the-slot-is-substituted-unconditionally
mutations._mechanism: Back-compat: a caller staging a pre-slot template with no --report-file would get the literal string None pasted in, or MISSING_SLOTS on a template that never asked for it.
mutations.find:
if report_file is not None:
        pairs = pairs + (("<INLINE_REPORT_FILE>", report_file),)

mutations.name: the-fallback-reason-is-discarded-again
mutations._mechanism: Four ways a report file fails to carry the verdict — not_requested / unreadable / empty / no_verdict_in_file — collapse to one token, so an agent that wrote NOTHING and one that wrote prose without a verdict print identically and the operator cannot tell which remedy applies. It also re-hides the `empty` branch, making its own guard untestable.
